company.name: Atomarine
company.shortDescription: Atomarine develops floating data centers powered by offshore vessels and cooled by seawater.
company.description: Atomarine develops floating data centers for compute workloads, using standardized platforms that are built in shipyards and cooled through seawater systems. The company pairs these platforms with separate power vessels, initially using natural-gas turbines while developing marine nuclear reactors for future deployment. Its infrastructure is intended for AI operators, developers, shipbuilders, energy partners, and other organizations that require offshore compute and power capacity.

productsAndServices.description: Floating platforms for compute workloads that use seawater cooling and connect to on-site power vessels.

productsAndServices.description: Ship-based power systems that supply electricity to Atomarine's offshore compute platforms.
